args.question:
Harbor Logistics (V-620) has two approved invoices, and your request mentioned only one. Which should I pay in full by wire (ACH if wire is unavailable)?
1) INV-18427: $7,803.36, due 2026-11-04
2) INV-82192: $4,381.98, due 2026-11-25
(Also note INV-31854 is a draft awaiting approval and INV-88522 is already paid, so I've left both alone.) Reply with the invoice ID and I'll pay it once.
